---
title: Dwell-time analyzer plots
jupyter: python3
---

This notebook shows every plot of the `tbsim.DwellTime` analyzer, which records how long each agent spends in each TB state, and which state they go to next.

```{python}
import tbsim
import starsim as ss
```

## Build a TB simulation with the dwell-time analyzer

The analyzer follows individual agents, so the simulation runs with agents (here on a random contact network, where `beta` is the transmission rate per contact per year). A quarter of the agents start with a latent infection, so that there are many transitions to record.

```{python}
def build_sim():
    """ Create an agent-based TB simulation with the dwell-time analyzer """
    sim = tbsim.Sim(
        tb = tbsim.TB(beta=3, init=dict(infection=0.25)),
        networks = ss.RandomNet(n_contacts=5, dur=0),
        analyzers = tbsim.DwellTime(scenario_name='Dwell-time example'),
        n_agents = 1000,
        start = '2013-01-01',
        stop = '2016-12-31',
        dt = ss.weeks(1),
        rand_seed = 123,
        verbose = 0,
    )
    return sim
```

## Run the simulation and get the analyzer

```{python}
sim = build_sim()
sim.run()
analyzer = sim.analyzers[0]
analyzer.data.head()
```

## 1. Network graph

A directed graph of the transitions between states, labeled with their mean dwell times and counts.

```{python}
analyzer.plot('network')
```

## 2. Histograms

Histograms of the dwell times in each state, by the state that comes next.

```{python}
analyzer.plot('histogram')
```

## 3. Survival analysis

Kaplan-Meier survival curves of the dwell times.

```{python}
analyzer.plot('kaplan_meier')
```

## 4. Validation

Histograms of the observed dwell times in each state, to compare with the distributions the model expects.

```{python}
analyzer.plot('validation')
```

## 5. Loading from a file

You can save the dwell-time data to a CSV file, and later create a `tbsim.DwellTime` from it to plot it.

```{python}
file_path = analyzer.save('dwelltime.csv')
print(f'Saved data file: {file_path}')

plotter = tbsim.DwellTime(file_path=file_path)
plotter.plot('histogram')
```
